list.title: Upstreams
list.emptyText: An upstream is an MCP server that you make available through mcpwarden. 1. Create the upstream. 2. Enter credentials. 3. Test the connection.
list.caption: Upstream list

import.title: Import mcpServers JSON
import.description: Paste the configuration of another client (Claude Desktop, Cursor). You see what would be created first.
import.label: mcpServers JSON
import.stdioNote: stdio entries are created disabled. They only run once you switch them on in the list. Check the command first.

approve.title: stdio approval
approve.networkText: Outbound is open. The SSRF protection does not apply to stdio processes.
approve.heading: {slug} is waiting for approval
approve.warnStrong: This upstream starts a process on the server.
approve.warnRest: Check the command before you approve it.
approve.capsError: The prerequisites could not be loaded. The server checks them on approval anyway.
approve.envNone: No variables set. You enter values yourself after approval.
approve.origin: {client} created it on {at} through the management tool, not you in the web UI.
approve.check1: I know this command and it comes from me.
approve.check2: The process only starts on the first call and ends when idle.
approve.check3: stdio is not restricted by SSRF protection; the process may access the network.
approve.approved: Approved. The process starts on the first call.

detail.timeoutsValue: Connect {connect} s · list {list} s · call {call} s
detail.noTools: No tools yet. Test the connection to fetch them.
detail.newSecretDesc: Stored secrets are never shown, only replaced.
detail.deleteText: “{name}” will be deleted along with its secrets and tool settings. Clients will lose the {n} tool immediately. | “{name}” will be deleted along with its secrets and tool settings. Clients will lose the {n} tools immediately.

test.hintSsrf: Target not allowed (SSRF protection). An admin can add exceptions under Admin › Instance.
test.hintUnauthorized: The credentials were rejected. Replace the secret in the "Auth" tab.
test.ok: Connection successful: {n} tool found ({latency}) | Connection successful: {n} tools found ({latency})

rest.tileHint: Your own tools from an API
rest.baseUrlDesc: Relative tool addresses ({sample}) are appended here. Leave empty if every tool has a full address.
rest.toolsDesc: Each tool is one HTTP call. Placeholders such as {sample} in the address, headers and body are filled from the parameters.
rest.empty: No tool yet. Add at least one so clients have something to call.
rest.name: Name
rest.descriptionDesc: The model reads this text to decide when to use the tool.
rest.urlTemplateDesc: A full http(s) address or a path starting with / relative to the base URL. Placeholders: {sample}.
rest.headersDesc: One header per line as Name: Value. Placeholders are allowed, Authorization and Host are not (sign-in comes from the upstream).
rest.bodyTemplateDesc: Optional for POST, PUT, PATCH. Without a body template, unused parameters are sent as a JSON body. A placeholder as a whole value keeps its type.
rest.invalidHeaders: Please write headers as “Name: Value”, one line per header.

form.tagsDesc: For grouping and filtering, at most 10 per upstream. Enter or comma adds a tag.
form.name: Display name
form.slugDesc: Part of the tool names; cannot be changed afterwards.
form.secretSet: A secret is set. It is never shown, only replaced.
form.secretUnset: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.cwdDesc: Relative to the user directory, without “..”.
form.oauthHint: After creating it, connect your account at the upstream in the “Auth” tab. The upstream must offer OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration.
form.oauthHintEdit: Manage the connection to your account at the upstream in the “Auth” tab.

probe.checking: Checking whether the server offers OAuth …
probe.dcr: OAuth detected: connect your account in the “Auth” tab after creating the upstream.
probe.no_dcr: The server offers OAuth without automatic registration. That is not supported yet, use Bearer or Header.
probe.none: No OAuth found. Choose None, Bearer or Header.
probe.error: OAuth could not be checked. You can still pick the sign-in yourself.

form.envDesc: Passed to the command. Values are stored as secrets.
form.envDescEdit: Values are never shown. Leave a value empty to keep it; new values replace the stored one.

oauth.explain: You sign in to the upstream in your browser. mcpwarden stores the tokens encrypted and renews them itself; they are never shown.
oauth.startFailed: Could not start the connection. Does the upstream offer OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration?
oauth.failed: Signing in to the upstream failed.

stats.slowNoteRecover: Status returns to healthy as soon as the value drops below it.
stats.heatAria: Status per hour over seven days: {err} hours with many errors, {warn} hours with a few errors.
stats.percentileAria: Latency over 24 hours: p50 now {p50}, p95 now {p95}
stats.errorsNote: Avg duration is the time until the error. Invalid arguments and tool errors do not count towards the breaker.
